female.sp: Preserve the RGM-79D GM Cold Districts Type as one clearly adult woman with a fully human face and exactly two biological arms and two legs. Translate the canonical off-white and pale gray cold-weather armor, dark charcoal joints, red chest and waist vents, green visor-sensor accents, wide rectangular shoulder armor, blocky chest intake geometry, broad front and side skirt plates, rounded forearm armor, elongated shin guards, broad cold-weather feet, and compact backpack faithfully. Keep both large shoulder armors present and symmetrical. Hold the compact 90mm bullpup-style machine gun in one hand at believable scale; retain the single beam-saber handle stowed on the backpack and do not duplicate either weapon. Integrate the green visor as a slim external sensor brow above the human eyes without hiding the face. The open armor may reveal tasteful, secure, fully opaque areas of skin at the upper torso, waist, hips and thighs while keeping the shoulders and all signature armor shapes intact. Upright humanoid form only; no robot head, no helmet covering the face, no extra limbs, no floating armor, no shield, no cape, no skirt-like fabric. Full-body vertical composition with the entire crest, shoulders, gun, hands, leg armor and feet inside frame. Keep the woman at the largest practical scale with minimal headroom, floor space and side margins; do not pull the camera back unnecessarily. Soft neutral studio background, no battlefield, no snowstorm, no pilot resemblance, no text, no logo, no watermark.
